versions.changelog:
Initial release: trust-based budget system for multi-agent teams

- Implements daily token limits per agent with automatic midnight resets
- Provides warning (yellow) and alert (red) thresholds based on usage
- Supports agent demotion and privilege revocation after repeated or extreme overages
- Includes governance audit logging and easy integration with any OpenClaw multi-agent setup
- Works entirely with local files for privacy and security
